final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as count_per_major FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(count_per_major) as total_count FROM step1) SELECT step1.link_to_major, step1.count_per_major, CAST(step1.count_per_major AS REAL) / step2.total_count as proportion FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY proportion DESC LIMIT 10
